syarat-ketentuan.title: Terms & Conditions
syarat-ketentuan.subtitle: Applies to all users of the sedekah.id platform.
syarat-ketentuan.html:
Welcome to sedekah.id, an online donation platform managed by DT Peduli (a National Zakat Management Institution). By accessing and using our services, you declare that you have read, understood, and agreed to all of the following terms and conditions. This document governs the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between sedekah.id and Donors, Muzakki, and Partners.

1. Definitions

  • Donor: an individual or entity that gives a donation in the form of money, goods, or services through sedekah.id.
  • Muzakki: an individual or entity that fulfills zakat through sedekah.id.
  • Partner: a third party that collaborates on sedekah.id / DT Peduli social and humanitarian programs.

2. General Terms

  • All donations received will be distributed according to the program purpose chosen by the donor.
  • sedekah.id is committed to managing zakat, infaq, sadaqah, and waqf funds in a trustworthy, transparent, and accountable manner.
  • Donations that have been received are in principle non-refundable, except under certain conditions with sedekah.id's approval.
  • Donations distributed through sedekah.id must come from lawful (halal) sources, not from activities that conflict with the law and sharia, and free from money laundering practices.

3. Rights and Obligations of the Donor / Muzakki

  • Entitled to receive reports on the use of their donated funds.
  • Obligated to provide accurate, correct, and complete data when donating.
  • Fully responsible for the validity and legality of the source of the donated funds.

4. Donation Methods

Donations can be made through:

  • Bank transfer / Virtual Account
  • QRIS and e-wallets (GoPay, ShopeePay, and others)
  • Credit card / debit card
  • International payment service (USD via PayPal) for overseas donors

Donors must follow the donation procedures available on sedekah.id so that donation records are accurate.

5. Use of Funds and Amil Fee (Ujrah)

The funds collected are used to support priority programs:

  • Education
  • Health
  • Economic empowerment
  • Emergency and disaster response
  • Other social and da'wah programs

Operational costs (amil fee / ujrah) are used to support fundraising, management, distribution, reporting, and donor services, with the following provisions:

  • A maximum of 12.5% of total zakat funds (including muqayyad zakat)
  • A maximum of 20% of total infaq/sadaqah funds (general or muqayyad)

Management refers to:

  • Law No. 23 of 2011 on Zakat Management
  • Minister of Religious Affairs Decree (KMA) No. 606 of 2020
  • DSN-MUI Fatwa No. 8 of 2011

6. Confidentiality and Personal Data Protection

sedekah.id is committed to protecting donors' personal data in accordance with Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection. Data is only used for:

  • Donation administration
  • Program communication
  • Delivery of reports and campaign information

Data will not be distributed to other parties without written consent, except for official reporting to the relevant authorities as required by law. Full details can be found on the Privacy Policy page.

7. Donor Statement of Consent

By donating through sedekah.id, I declare that:

  • All donations come from lawful (halal) funds and not from activities that conflict with the law or sharia.
  • The funds I donate are legally my personal or institutional property.
  • For zakat donations, the wealth I give has reached the nishab, met the haul, and comes from assets subject to zakat in accordance with Islamic sharia.

I also agree that:

  • sedekah.id stores and processes my data for the purpose of donation services.
  • sedekah.id may contact me about programs, reports, and campaigns through official channels.
  • sedekah.id may use a portion of the funds as an amil fee (ujrah) in accordance with applicable laws and fatwas.

8. Cookie Policy

By using this site, I agree to the use of cookies for:

  • Unique device identification
  • Improving the user experience on the site
  • Cookie storage for a maximum of 1 year, manageable through browser settings

9. Changes to the Terms and Conditions

  • sedekah.id may change these terms and conditions at any time.
  • Changes will be announced officially through sedekah.id.
  • Users are encouraged to check this page periodically.

10. Closing

Thank you for your trust and contribution to the community through sedekah.id. May Allah SWT reward every good deed many times over.

For further questions, please contact us by email at donasi@dtp.id.

kebijakan-privasi.title: Privacy Policy
kebijakan-privasi.subtitle: How we keep your data safe at sedekah.id.
kebijakan-privasi.html:
Welcome

Welcome to sedekah.id, an online donation platform managed by DT Peduli. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our services as well as integrated services on other platforms. We are committed to keeping your data confidential and secure. By accessing our services, you agree to this policy and its terms.

Information We Collect

We may collect your personal information when you visit the site, subscribe to the newsletter, fill in a donation form, or interact with us through our various service channels. The information we may collect includes:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • WhatsApp / phone number
  • Mailing address (if you provide it)
  • Payment and transaction information (when you donate — most of it is processed directly by our payment gateway providers and is not stored on sedekah.id servers)
  • Technical data: IP address, user agent, and session information for security and audit purposes

Use of Information

The personal information collected from our site is used to:

  • Process your donation and send donation confirmations
  • Send updates about programs and activities
  • Provide better donor support services
  • Improve the user experience on the site
  • Conduct internal analysis to improve our services
  • Report officially to the competent authorities as required by law

Third-Party and Social Media Integrations

To process donations and run our services, sedekah.id integrates with several third parties, including:

  • Payment Gateways (Midtrans, WinPay, PayPal, and others) — for processing donation payments.
  • WhatsApp / Qiscus / Innovasia — for delivering login OTPs and donation confirmation notifications.
  • Email service (SMTP) — for delivering receipts and reports.
  • Analytics services (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel) — for measuring campaign effectiveness and optimizing the site.

Each third party has its own privacy policy. We encourage you to read those policies before using their services.

Information Security

We take reasonable, industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, including encryption of sensitive data (AES-256-GCM for gateway credentials) and password hashing (bcrypt). However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our site uses technologies such as cookies to automatically collect certain information. Cookies are small files stored on your device to uniquely identify the device and enhance your experience. You can set your browser to refuse cookies or to notify you when a cookie is sent. Please note that disabling cookies may affect some site features.

Data Retention and Donor Rights

In accordance with Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we store about you
  • Update or correct inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your personal data (except data that must be retained for compliance with zakat / tax reporting regulations)
  • Withdraw consent for certain data processing

To submit a request regarding your personal data, please email donasi@dtp.id.

External Links

Our site may contain links to external sites that we do not manage. We are not responsible for their content or privacy policies. We encourage you to review their policies before sharing any information.

Changes to This Policy

This privacy policy may be updated from time to time as technology and applicable regulations evolve. Significant changes will be announced on this page. Your continued use of our site means you accept those changes.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us by email at donasi@dtp.id.

hapus-akun.title: Delete Account
hapus-akun.subtitle: How to delete your sedekah.id account and its data.
hapus-akun.html:
How to delete your account (self-service)

  1. Sign in to your account at sedekah.id/akun (in the app or a browser).
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the Account page, then tap Delete Account.
  3. Read the consequences, tick the confirmation box, then tap Yes, Delete My Account.

Your account is deactivated and profile data deleted immediately. This cannot be undone.

Can't sign in?

Send a deletion request to donasi@dtp.id from your registered email address, or include the WhatsApp number registered to your account so we can verify ownership. Requests are processed within 30 days of identity verification.

Data that is deleted

  • Profile data: name, email address, WhatsApp number, profile photo, date of birth, city, and occupation.
  • Sign-in credentials (the account can no longer be used) and all login sessions on every device.
  • Recurring giving (Shadaqa Rutin) schedules and their reminders are permanently stopped.

Data that is retained

Donation transaction records (amount, date, campaign) are retained to comply with the organisation's financial record-keeping and audit obligations under applicable law. Once your account is deleted, those transactions are no longer linked to your profile and your name is not displayed anywhere in the service.

Questions

See our Privacy Policy, or contact donasi@dtp.id.
